derivation: Selected L/C category ranges, default full casefold, canonical combining classes, canonical decompositions and NFC-valid composition pairs. Algorithmic Hangul is implemented in code, not expanded in the runtime table. No Python executable or private data is distributed.
rejected_route: Resident macOS SDK/runtime ICU reports Unicode17, so it is not treated as Unicode16. No hidden/private normalization symbols or locale lowercasing substitution.
claims: Regeneration and differential vectors cover data/algorithm behavior only, not real editor, Keychain, GUI, provider, physical-phone or full-product acceptance.
android_packaging: Java resource /dev/lip/vocabulary/unicode16.json, loaded lazily and SHA/version checked; actual Android classloader qualification is separate.
